title: Correct contract types and architecture invariants to match spike/README.md and design doc

outcome: HookEventName includes SessionEnd and SubagentStop (not in Bob 2.2.0); hook payload types are missing event-specific fields; CardRecord lacks question and options; AnswerRecord uses agree/disagree/ask_why instead of pick+text; MessageRecord.card is required; build output is not gitignored; architecture.md merges localhost and contract-types into one invariant and misstates the hold rule.

HookEventName matches Bob 2.2.0 exactly (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, Stop); each hook payload type carries its event-specific fields from spike/README.md; CardRecord carries question and options with Bob's claim as option 'bob'; AnswerRecord carries pick and text; MessageRecord.card is optional; dist/ and *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored; architecture.md lists localhost-only and contract-types-in-one-package as separate invariants and states the hold rule as 'each check_in waits at most 45 s, at most 3 waits per hold'.
forbid: no product features — no server, hooks, or page

evidence: npm run typecheck exits 0; npm test exits 0 (12 tests pass); HookEventName matches Bob 2.2.0 exactly; all event-specific payload fields present; CardRecord has question+options; AnswerRecord has pick+text; MessageRecord.card is optional; dist/ and *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored; architecture.md has 6 invariants with localhost and contract-types separated and hold rule corrected

disposition: Corrected contract types and architecture invariants: HookEventName is the exact Bob 2.2.0 seven-event set; seven concrete payload types with event-specific fields; CardRecord carries question+options (bob option); AnswerRecord uses pick+text; MessageRecord.card optional; dist/ and *.tsbuildinfo gitignored; architecture.md split into 6 invariants (5=localhost, 6=contract-types) with corrected hold rule. 12 tests pass.
